name: Carlac Minerals
note: French surfacing-minerals group ('French family-owned industrial group', carlacminerals.fr); reported elsewhere as the Hériau family business of #21 driver François Hériau, but the sources for that (Le Journal des Entreprises on the Soka takeover, Ouest-France) were blocked/rate-limited to me, so the family name is not cited from an opened page; the 'Carrières des Lacs' alias was removed for the same reason. Logo on the #21 car in the 2026 livery renders. Owner claim not written: no opened source names the owner.
